text: An operator T is diagonalizable if and only if its minimal polynomial m_T:
choices: splits into distinct linear factors over F
has degree equal to dim V
explanation: Diagonalizability is equivalent to m_T having no repeated roots (and all roots in F): each Jordan block of size k forces a factor (λ − λ₀)ᵏ in m_T. Note m_T = p_T instead characterizes cyclic operators — a single companion block.
